crossRefs.note: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

parallels.note: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

people.name: Elim
people.line: Desert oasis on Israel's journey from Egypt to Sinai

people.name: Marah
people.line: A place with bitter water on the Exodus route

translations.web: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
translations.bsb: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and threescore and ten palm-trees; and they encamped there.
